newsitem.title: UK: KEPIT questions TR European portfolio trade.
newsitem.headline: KEPIT questions TR European portfolio trade.

text.p: Kleinwort European Privatisation Investment Trust Plc has asked hostile bidder TR European Growth Trust to provide details of the programme trade it has arranged for the disposal of the 500 million pound investment trust.

"Does TREG currently have a legally binding arrangement by which it is guaranteed to be able to sell KEPITs entire portfolio at a particular price or discount to prevailing market prices on a particular day?" KEPIT chairman Shane Ross said in a statement.
